definitions.explanation: A fixed interval at which something repeats regularly, used in science, economics, and everyday life for any recurring pattern such as seasons, tides, or business fluctuations.

examples.english: The cycle of the moon is about 29.5 days.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{現象|げんしょう}→現象：02718_genshou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{周期|しゅうき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}される→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧。
examples.english: This phenomenon repeats at a fixed cycle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{好況|こうきょう}→好況：04846_koukyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧{周期|しゅうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that the economy has a cycle of alternating between booms and recessions.

notes:
Refers to a repeating interval or cycle in which something occurs regularly. Combines {周|しゅう} (circumference, go around) and {期|き} (period, term).

USAGE:
- Used in scientific, medical, and general contexts for any recurring pattern
- Common in discussions of astronomy, biology, economics, and physics
- Can refer to both natural cycles (seasons, tides) and human-made cycles (business cycles)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {周期|しゅうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧: short cycle
- {周期|しゅうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧: long cycle
- ⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{周期|しゅうき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: at a regular interval
- {周期|しゅうき}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: periodically, cyclically
- {生理|せいり}{周期|しゅうき}: menstrual cycle
- ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧{周期|しゅうき}: business cycle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- サイクル: cycle — the loanword equivalent, common in casual and business contexts
- ⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: period, duration — a span of time, not necessarily repeating
- ⟦{頻度|ひんど}→頻度：14619_hindo⟧: frequency — how often something occurs, rather than the interval itself
